cards.title: Archive
cards.body: The peer-to-peer storage network is live. Nodes run on home computers, connect directly through NAT without configuration. Every handshake uses post-quantum cryptography - ML-DSA-65 and ML-KEM-768, both NIST-standardised. No classical fallbacks. Data is self-encrypted using ChaCha20-Poly1305 + BLAKE3. Pay once per upload. No subscriptions, no egress fees.

cards.title: x0x
cards.body: Post-quantum encrypted gossip networking. Agents discover each other, share skills, synchronise state, and collaborate without central servers. Secured private groups using TreeKEM - invite, join, ban, forward-secrecy membership. Running on a production fleet across NYC, SFO, Helsinki, Nuremberg, Singapore, and Sydney.

cards.title: Indelible
cards.body: Free, open-source gateway. REST API, Docker deployment, collections, tagging, bulk ops. Enterprise SSO (Okta, Entra, Google), SCIM 2.0, multi-wallet. [indelibletool.com](https://indelibletool.com)

cards.title: Desktop App
cards.body: Mac, Windows, Linux. 18 languages. Upload files, run a node and earn ANT. Dark mode, auto-updates, built-in wallet.

cards.title: The Reading Room
cards.body: Curated, open-access library stored on Archive. Four books, 442 sources, 78,000 words, audio narration. [reading-room.com](https://reading-room.com)

cards.title: SDKs and CLI
cards.sub: Build on Autonomi from any language
cards.body: 15+ language SDKs: Python, Go, Rust, JavaScript, Java, Kotlin, C#, Swift, and more. gRPC and REST interfaces.

cards.title: Browser Extension
cards.sub: Access the network directly from your browser
cards.body: A web extension for Chrome and Firefox (and Chromium/Gecko derivatives) that lets you download autonomi:// links directly from the network without a proxy or intermediary. Runs the antd daemon in the background automatically.

cards.title: ANT Token
cards.body: Live on Arbitrum. Merkle Tree batch payments and single-node payments. Total supply: 1.2 billion. Available on MEXC, Uniswap V3, BitMart, Ourbit.

cards.title: Post-Quantum Security
cards.body: ML-DSA-65 signatures, ML-KEM-768 key exchange. NIST-standardised. First of its kind at this scale.

cards.title: QUIC NAT Traversal
cards.body: Nodes connect peer-to-peer through residential NAT without configuration.

cards.title: Self-Encryption
cards.sub: Impossible to read without your keys
cards.body: ChaCha20-Poly1305 + BLAKE3. Content-addressed, convergent, geographically distributed.

cards.title: Node Reputation
cards.body: EigenTrust scoring, sybil resistance, eclipse protection, geographic diversity.

cards.title: Auto Upgrades
cards.body: Nodes upgrade automatically with integrity verification. No manual intervention.

cards.title: Data Payments
cards.body: Merkle Tree batch payments for reduced gas. Single-node payments for simplicity. All via ANT.

cards.title: Fae
cards.sub: Your local AI that becomes part of something bigger
cards.body: Privacy-first AI agent on your machine. No cloud, no internet required. Being redesigned as headless and cross-platform - Swift for Apple, Dioxus for Windows/Linux/iOS/Android. Via x0x, your Fae connects to your friends' Fae agents to form "The Fae" - trusted communities that share capabilities, collaborate on tasks, and help each other.

cards.title: Trust Layer
cards.body: On-chain marketplace where agents stake real tokens behind their claims. Disputes resolved using immutable evidence stored on Archive and adjudicated by independent AI resolvers. Bounty hunters challenge agents with inflated reputations. Your reputation is financial - you can't fake it without risking real money. Proof of concept live on Base testnet.

cards.title: Storage Auditing
cards.sub: Proving nodes store what they claim
cards.body: Lightweight challenge on existing gossip. Merkle root hash + random nonce. Tested on 400 nodes, 5 regions, zero false positives.

cards.title: Faster Uploads + Downloads
cards.body: Byte-aware throughput optimiser. ~2x faster downloads. First 2.7GB production upload in 30 minutes.

cards.title: Agent Skill Sharing
cards.body: Share agent skills across devices and users. Private groups, public feeds, collaborative improvement.

cards.title: Communitas
cards.body: Full collaboration suite on x0x. Board, Chat, Docs, Canvas, Drive, Calls - all peer-to-peer with post-quantum encryption.

cards.title: Clock Tolerance
cards.body: Storage-state verification replacing timestamp-based validation. Critical for Windows and dual-boot users.

cards.title: Bootstrap Cache
cards.body: Smarter startup, IP diversity, sector-balanced peer selection. Reduced time-to-first-operation.

cards.title: Mobile SDKs
cards.body: Native Swift and Kotlin bindings. xcframework and AAR packaging. iOS test app built.

cards.title: Four-Word Addresses
cards.body: Human-readable, verbally shareable four-word addresses replacing cryptographic hashes and IPs.

cards.title: Indelible Hardening
cards.body: Content dedup, improved search, lazy-loading collections, activity metrics, CSRF protection.

cards.title: Voice and Video
cards.body: WebRTC over QUIC. No STUN/TURN servers. Uses the network's own NAT traversal. 224 tests passing.

cards.title: Compute Mesh
cards.body: Pool computing resources across trusted friends' machines. ML inference, shared GPU access, slot-based reservations.

cards.title: Symphony
cards.body: Specialised agents forming teams, dispatching tasks, collaborating on complex work. CRDT-backed, partition-tolerant.

cards.title: Payment Gateway
cards.sub: More ways to pay for storage
cards.body: Credit or debit card, stablecoins, or ANT directly. No crypto knowledge required for those who don't want it.

cards.title: Agentic Payments
cards.body: Machine-to-machine payment protocols. Agents pay each other using ANT - directly, programmatically, at scale.

cards.title: AI-Native Networking
cards.body: Intelligent routing, predictive optimisation, adaptive resource allocation.

cards.title: Quantum Threshold Crypto
cards.body: Multi-party computation using post-quantum primitives. Shared custody, threshold signing.
